messages.text: Hi, I sent the USB charger back, it stopped working after a day. Can I get a refund?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"refund for returned defective item; product stopped working after one day, eligibility and whether staff review needed"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/approval", "title": "Confirmation and approval", "text": "Every refund needs two separate decisions: the customer confirms the exact proposal (items, quantities and amount) with the button on the proposal card, and a staff member approves it. Changing anything in a proposal needs a new proposal, a new confirmation and a new approval. A staff member cannot approve a refund that this policy does not allow."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

tool_calls.arguments: {"order_id":"h04-o1","unit_ids":["h04-o1-u1"],"summary_for_staff":"Customer reports USB wall charger stopped working after one day; requests refund."}

messages.text: Your returned USB wall charger is eligible for a refund of BRL 13.65. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on the proposal card; typing “yes” here won’t confirm it. After that, a staff member will review the request.
The customer confirmed request prop-0e5acca77fc84fd1 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
Your refund of BRL 13.65 has been processed. Receipt number: **R-00000001**.
Thanks. What date should the refund reach my card?

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"when does a processed refund reach the customer's card; timing after refund payment"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/payment", "title": "Where the money goes", "text": "A refund is paid automatically only when the order has exactly one payment record and that record is valid (a known payment method and a positive amount), and only to that payment. Instalments of one payment are one payment record. In every other case a staff member takes the case. A refund can never be sent to another person, account or card."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/validity", "title": "How long a proposal is valid", "text": "A proposal can be confirmed, approved or paid only strictly before it expires, 72 hours after it is created. After that it expires together with its confirmation and approval, and a new proposal is needed. A proposal also stops being valid if the order or this policy changes before it is paid. Expiry stops new payments only: a refund already paid stays paid, and its receipt can always be retrieved."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

messages.text: The shop’s records confirm the refund was paid on October 21, but they don’t specify when it will appear on your card. I can’t give you an exact arrival date.
Do you know if it should arrive within a few days?
I don’t have a confirmed timeframe for when it will appear on your card, so I can’t say whether it should arrive within a few days.
